references.text: Here the Sabbath is introduced as a day of rest dedicated to the Lord, providing background for Jesus' claim to be Lord of the Sabbath.
This passage deals with how the Sabbath should be kept holy, emphasizing the importance of the Sabbath that Jesus refers to.
Here the Sabbath rest is spoken of as a picture of the rest believers are to enter, pointing forward to Jesus' role as Lord of the Sabbath.
In this passage Jesus defends his disciples' actions on the Sabbath, leading up to his statement about being Lord of the Sabbath.
